items.title: Checkout retries a declined card once
items.subtitle: storefront #482

exhibit.html:
• Checkout now retries a card the processor declined for a temporary reason.
  • It retries once, then shows the shopper an error.

references.label: storefront #482
references.description: Retries a card the processor declined for a transient reason, once, before showing the shopper an error.

items.description:
## What changed

Checkout retries a transient decline once before failing the order.
